body.heading: Your application is in!
paragraphs: Thanks for putting your name in the hat. We'll review everything and reach out with any questions.
In the meantime, look out for a follow-up email from us with more info about who we are and how to get involved.

body.subject: A bit more about Opportunity Outdoors
body.heading: Here's how this works
paragraphs: Opportunity Outdoors is a North Carolina nonprofit that pairs new hunters and anglers with experienced mentors. Our mentors are volunteers who donate their time to pass on the skills, ethics, and conservation mindset. Keep in mind, this isn't a guide service. You get out what you put in.
Camps are the core of what we do, but we also run community days and workshops that anyone can join. Take a look at what's coming up and come out and meet us.

body.subject: A bit more about Opportunity Outdoors
body.heading: Here's how this works
paragraphs: Opportunity Outdoors is a North Carolina nonprofit that pairs new hunters and anglers with experienced mentors. Camps are the core of it: a few days in the field where a mentor takes one or two mentees through a hunt or a fishing trip start to finish. That said, we're not guides and we don't expect you to be either.
We also run community days and workshops, which are a lower commitment than a full camp and a good place to meet the crew. Take a look at what's coming up and let us know if something works for you.
